source.text: Παῦλος καὶ Τιμόθεος δοῦλοι Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τοῖς οὖσιν ἐν Φιλίπποις σὺν ἐπισκόποις καὶ διακόνοις·

records.literal_gloss: Paul and Timothy, slaves of Christ Jesus, to all the holy ones in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, with overseers and deacons;

en.L: Paul and Timothy, slaves of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus, to all the holy ones in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus who are in Philippi, with [the] overseers and deacons.
en.B: From Paul and Timothy, servants of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, to all God's holy people in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus who live in Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons.
en.R: This letter is from Paul and Timothy. We are servants who belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. We are writing to all of God's holy people in Philippi who belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, and also to the leaders who watch over the church and those who serve it.

fr.L: Paul et Timothée, esclaves du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, à tous les saints {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus qui sont à Philippes, avec les surveillants et les diacres.
fr.B: De la part de Paul et de Timothée, serviteurs du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, à tout le peuple saint de Dieu {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus qui vit à Philippes, ainsi qu’aux surveillants et aux diacres.
fr.R: Cette lettre vient de Paul et de Timothée. Nous sommes des serviteurs qui appartiennent au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus. Nous écrivons à tout le peuple saint de Dieu qui vit à Philippes et qui appartient au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, et aussi aux responsables qui veillent sur l’église et à ceux qui la servent.

es.L: Pablo y Timoteo, esclavos de {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús, a todos los santos en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús que están en Filipos, con [los] supervisores y diáconos.
es.B: De Pablo y Timoteo, siervos {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús, a todo el pueblo santo de Dios en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús que vive en Filipos, junto con los supervisores y diáconos.
es.R: Esta carta es de Pablo y de Timoteo. Somos siervos y pertenecemos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} Jesús. Escribimos a todo el pueblo de Dios en Filipos que pertenece {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} Jesús, y también a los líderes que cuidan de la iglesia y a los que la sirven.

sw.L: Paulo na Timotheo, watumwa wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, kwa watakatifu wote katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu walioko Filipi, pamoja na waangalizi na mashemasi.
sw.B: Kutoka kwa Paulo na Timotheo, watumishi wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, kwa watu wote watakatifu wa Mungu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu walioko Filipi, pamoja na waangalizi na mashemasi.
sw.R: Barua hii inatoka kwa Paulo na Timotheo. Sisi ni watumishi wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. Tunawaandikia watu wote wa Mungu walioko Filipi, walio wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, pamoja na viongozi wanaolisimamia kanisa na wale wanaolihudumia.

ko.L: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수의 종들인 바울과 디모데가, 빌립보에 있는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안의 모든 성도와 감독들과 집사들에게 [편지합니다].
ko.B: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수의 종인 바울과 디모데가, 빌립보에 사는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안의 모든 성도와 감독들과 집사들에게 이 편지를 씁니다.
ko.R: 이 편지는 바울과 디모데가 보냅니다. 우리는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께 속한 종입니다. 우리는 빌립보에 사는 하나님의 거룩한 백성, 곧 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께 속한 모든 사람에게, 그리고 교회를 돌보는 지도자들과 교회를 섬기는 사람들에게 이 편지를 씁니다.

vi.L: Phao-lô và Ti-mô-thê, nô lệ của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu, gửi đến tất cả các thánh đồ trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu ở Phi-líp, cùng với các người giám sát và các chấp sự.
vi.B: Phao-lô và Ti-mô-thê, đầy tớ của Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, kính gửi tất cả dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} đang sống tại Phi-líp, cùng với các người giám sát và các chấp sự.
vi.R: Thư này của Phao-lô và Ti-mô-thê. Chúng tôi là đầy tớ thuộc về Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. Chúng tôi viết cho tất cả dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời ở Phi-líp, là những người thuộc về Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, và cũng gửi đến những người lãnh đạo coi sóc Hội Thánh và những người phục vụ Hội Thánh.

pt.L: Paulo e Timóteo, escravos {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} Jesus, a todos os santos {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus que estão em Filipos, com [os] supervisores e diáconos.
pt.B: De Paulo e Timóteo, servos {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} Jesus, a todo o povo santo de Deus {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus que vive em Filipos, junto com os supervisores e diáconos.
pt.R: Esta carta é de Paulo e Timóteo. Nós somos servos que pertencem {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} Jesus. Escrevemos a todo o povo santo de Deus em Filipos, que pertence {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} Jesus, e também aos líderes que cuidam da igreja e aos que a servem.

decisions.choice: slaves: people owned by their master and wholly at his service
decisions.reason: δοῦλοι is the ordinary word for a slave, someone who belongs to another, not a hired servant who could leave. Paul and Timothy describe themselves as owned by Christ Jesus. In the Greek Old Testament the same word also gives an honored title to Moses and David as "servants of the Lord" (Joshua 14:7; 2 Samuel 7:5), so it carries both humility and honor. Paul will use it of Christ himself in 2:7.

decisions.choice: people set apart as belonging to God
decisions.reason: ἁγίοις describes every believer, not a select few: the whole church is God's holy people, as Israel was (Exodus 19:6), set apart "in Christ Jesus".

decisions.choice: overseers: the leaders who watched over the church
alternatives: bishops, in the later sense of one bishop over many churches
decisions.reason: ἐπισκόποις means someone who watches over others. The word is plural and the church is one town's church, so it names a group of local leaders; in Acts 20:17 and 20:28 the same people are called elders and overseers. The later pattern of one bishop over a region is not in view.

decisions.choice: a recognized group who served the church alongside the overseers
alternatives: deacons as a later church office
decisions.reason: διακόνοις means one who serves or assists. Named next to the overseers, it refers to a known group in the church (compare 1 Timothy 3:8-13), but the letter does not say what their duties were, and nothing should be read in from later church structures.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "Christ Jesus"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT marks a variant in the order of these two names. The meaning does not change, so there is no footnote.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that the person was owned, and Literal keeps "slave". Readable keeps the idea of belonging.

decisions.choice: holy ones (L); God's holy people (B, R)
decisions.reason: In current English "saints" usually means unusually good people or those honored by a church; Paul is writing to the whole congregation.

decisions.choice: those who serve the church
decisions.reason: Readable says what the word means rather than using a church title.

decisions.choice: who belong to Christ Jesus
decisions.reason: "In Christ" means being united with him; Readable says so plainly.

decisions.choice: "du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}", "au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}"; "{{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}" for "in Christ"; "Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}" at Balanced and Readable (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians: French cannot say "en Messie", so the span for "in Christ" covers the preposition, with the familiar "en Christ" as the default. Elsewhere the article stays outside the span, since "du Christ" and "du Messie" both read naturally; Literal adds it without brackets, as French needs it.

decisions.choice: esclaves (L), serviteurs (B, R); les saints (L), le peuple saint de Dieu (B, R); les surveillants et les diacres (L, B), les responsables ... et ceux qui la servent (R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: The terms of the New Testament term sheet, as in Colossians. "Évêques" would suggest a later church office; "surveillants" says what the word means (m3). Readable describes both groups by what they do, as the English Readable does, and "l’église" has the lowercase of a single congregation.

decisions.choice: esclavos (L); siervos (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the English and the other letters: Literal keeps "esclavos", the hard word for someone owned by a master (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable say "siervos". The same throughout Philippians.

decisions.choice: santos (L); pueblo santo de Dios (B); pueblo de Dios (R); supervisores y diáconos (L, B)
decisions.reason: "Santos" now usually means people the church has canonized, so Balanced and Readable say what Paul means, as Philippians 4:21 does. "Obispos" would bring in a later church rank; "supervisores" says what these leaders did (meaning decision m3). Readable explains both groups, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: watumwa (L); watumishi (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Romans and the project's NT terms: "mtumwa" (slave) in Literal, "mtumishi" (servant) in Balanced and Readable, as the English has "servants". The meaning decision (m1) keeps that a slave was owned by his master; the same pattern holds in 2:7, where Christ takes "the form of a slave".

decisions.choice: waangalizi na mashemasi (L, B); viongozi wanaolisimamia kanisa na wale wanaolihudumia (R)
decisions.reason: "Mwangalizi" (one who watches over) for episkopos, as in Titus 1:7, and "shemasi" for a recognized servant of the church, as Phoebe in Romans 16:1, rather than the general "mhudumu", because here the word names a group (m4). Readable explains both, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the whole letter in 합쇼체 (-습니다, -십시오) at every level; the readers are "여러분"; Paul speaks of himself as "나" and "우리"; God and Christ take the honorific -시- and 께서; no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: As in the Korean of Colossians and Romans: a letter read aloud to the gathered church calls for the formal style of a public address, so every level uses 합쇼체, and "여러분" is the respectful plural "you". Korean has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change; respect for God and Christ is carried by -시-, 께서 and "그분".

decisions.choice: "종" at every level for Paul and Timothy, through the letter; "노예" kept for slavery itself
decisions.reason: The English has "slave" in Literal and "servant" in Balanced and Readable. Korean "종" already says that a person belongs wholly to a master, without the picture of modern slavery that "노예" brings, so the style guide keeps one word at every level, as in Romans 1:1 and Galatians 1:10. In 2:7 Christ takes "the form of a slave", where the same word is kept.

decisions.choice: "성도" (L, B); "하나님의 거룩한 백성" (R), through the letter; {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} at every level; "복음" (L, B) / "기쁜 소식" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians and Romans: "성도" is the ordinary Korean church word for every believer; Readable says the plain sense, and says "기쁜 소식" for the gospel, as the English Readable says "good news". Korean has no article, so the christos alternative is plain "메시아".

decisions.choice: "감독들과 집사들" (L, B); "교회를 돌보는 지도자들과 교회를 섬기는 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: "감독" (overseer) and "집사" (deacon, one who serves) are the established Protestant words for these two groups (the meaning decisions); "주교" and "부제" are Catholic titles. Readable says what each group did, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "tôi" for Paul, "chúng tôi" for Paul and Timothy, "chúng ta" where the readers are included, and "anh chị em" for "you" (plural) through the whole letter
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Colossians and Romans. Paul founded this church and writes with deep affection (1:8; 4:1), but as a partner among brothers and sisters (1:5, 12), so the readers are "anh chị em".

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" (L); "đầy tớ" (B, R) for doulos (for the whole letter, except where slavery itself is the point)
decisions.reason: As in the English and the Vietnamese Colossians: Literal keeps "slave", one owned by a master (m1), and Balanced and Readable say "đầy tớ".

decisions.choice: "các người giám sát và các chấp sự" (L, B); "những người lãnh đạo coi sóc Hội Thánh và những người phục vụ Hội Thánh" (R)
decisions.reason: The overseers watched over the church (m3), and the deacons were a recognized group who served it (m4). "Giám mục" now names a bishop over many churches; "người giám sát" says what the word means. "Chấp sự" is the church name for the recognized office, as in the Vietnamese Romans (16:1); Readable says what both did, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "các thánh đồ" (L); "dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời" (B, R); "Phi-líp", "Ti-mô-thê"
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Colossians (1:2-4), for the whole letter. "Phi-líp" is the Protestant form for the city, as it is for the apostle Philip.

decisions.choice: supervisores e diáconos (L, B); os líderes que cuidam da igreja e os que a servem (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as docs/portuguese-style.md section 6 sets it. "Bispos" would suggest the later office of one bishop over a region, which m3 rules out; "supervisor" says what the word means, someone who watches over others. "Diáconos" is kept at L and B as a known group (m4); Readable describes both groups, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: escravos, santos (L); servos, o povo santo de Deus (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as Romans has it: Literal keeps "escravos", which says that Paul and Timothy belong wholly to Christ (m1), and "santos"; Balanced and Readable say "servos" and "povo santo de Deus", because in Brazil "os santos" suggests a few canonised saints, while m2 means the whole church.

source.text: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Grace to you and peace from God Father of us and Lord Jesus Christ.

en.L: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and [the] Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} will show you grace and give you peace.

fr.L: Grâce à vous et paix de la part de Dieu notre Père et du Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Grâce et paix à vous de la part de Dieu notre Père et du Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.R: Je prie pour que Dieu notre Père et le Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} vous montrent leur grâce et vous donnent la paix.

es.L: Gracia a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y paz de parte de Dios nuestro Padre y [del] Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.B: Gracia y paz a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} de parte de Dios nuestro Padre y del Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.R: Pido que Dios nuestro Padre y el Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} {{plural_you:les|os}} den gracia y paz.

sw.L: Neema kwenu na amani kutoka kwa Mungu Baba yetu na Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Neema na amani ziwe nanyi kutoka kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kutoka kwa Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Ninaomba kwamba Mungu Baba yetu na Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wawaonyeshe neema na kuwapa amani.

ko.L: 하나님 우리 아버지와 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께로부터 은혜와 평안이 여러분에게 [있기를 빕니다].
ko.B: 하나님 우리 아버지와 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분에게 은혜와 평안을 주시기를 빕니다.
ko.R: 우리 아버지 하나님과 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분에게 은혜를 베푸시고 평안을 주시기를 기도합니다.

vi.L: Ân điển và bình an cho anh chị em từ Đức Chúa Trời, Cha chúng ta, và Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Nguyện ân điển và bình an từ Đức Chúa Trời, Cha chúng ta, và từ Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} ở cùng anh chị em.
vi.R: Tôi cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời, Cha chúng ta, và Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} ban ân điển và bình an cho anh chị em.

pt.L: Graça a vocês e paz da parte de Deus, nosso Pai, e [do] Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}.
pt.B: Graça e paz a vocês da parte de Deus, nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.
pt.R: Eu oro para que Deus, nosso Pai, e o Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} deem graça e paz a vocês.

decisions.choice: one source: God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ together
decisions.reason: A single ἀπὸ ("from") governs both names, so Jesus is named with God the Father as the one source of grace and peace. Paul opens almost every letter this way (Romans 1:7; 1 Corinthians 1:3).

decisions.choice: a greeting turned into a blessing
decisions.reason: Greek letters normally opened with a one-word "greetings". Paul replaces it with χάρις (grace), a word close to it in sound, and adds εἰρήνη (peace), the usual Jewish greeting. It is a wish and a prayer for God's favor and wholeness.

decisions.choice: Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: I pray that ... will show you grace and give you peace
decisions.reason: The greeting has no verb. Readable states it as the prayer it is, so young readers do not read it as a heading.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Paul writes to the church in the plural throughout the letter. Every plural "you" and every verb addressed to the readers is a reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain), as in Philippians 4.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}
decisions.reason: As in Philippians 4:23: the default is the usual Spanish name "Jesucristo", and the alternative separates name and title. Where a comma must follow the alternative, it sits inside the span.

decisions.choice: "은혜와 평안" at every level, through the letter
decisions.reason: The key terms take the words settled in the Korean of John, Colossians and Romans: "은혜" for grace and "평안" for the peace God gives (4:7, 4:9).

decisions.choice: Chúa Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} for "the Lord Jesus Christ"; {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu (L), Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} (B, R) for "Christ Jesus"; {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} for "Christ" alone (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The forms set in the Vietnamese Colossians: with "Lord", "Chúa" takes the place of the honorific "Đức".

source.text: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ θεῷ μου ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ μνείᾳ ὑμῶν πάντοτε ἐν πάσῃ δεήσει μου ὑπὲρ πάντων ὑμῶν, μετὰ χαρᾶς τὴν δέησιν ποιούμενος, ἐπὶ τῇ κοινωνίᾳ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἀπὸ τῆς πρώτης ἡμέρας ἄχρι τοῦ νῦν, πεποιθὼς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ὅτι ὁ ἐναρξάμενος ἐν ὑμῖν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἐπιτελέσει ἄχρι ἡμέρας Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ· καθώς ἐστιν δίκαιον ἐμοὶ τοῦτο φρονεῖν ὑπὲρ πάντων ὑμῶν, διὰ τὸ ἔχειν με ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμᾶς, ἔν τε τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀπολογίᾳ καὶ βεβαιώσει τοῦ εὐαγγελίου συγκοινωνούς μου τῆς χάριτος πάντας ὑμᾶς ὄντας·

records.literal_gloss: I thank the God of me upon every the remembrance of you, \v 4 always in every prayer of me for all of you, with joy the prayer making, \v 5 for the partnership of you in the gospel from the first day until the now, \v 6 having been persuaded of this very thing, that the [one] having begun in you a work good will complete [it] until [the] day of Christ Jesus; \v 7 just as it is right for me this to think on behalf of all of you, because of the to have me in the heart you, both in the chains of me and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, fellow sharers of me of the grace all you being.

en.L: I thank my God at every remembrance of you, \v 4 always in every prayer of mine for all of you, making the prayer with joy, \v 5 because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now, \v 6 being persuaded of this very thing, that the [one] who began a good work in you will complete [it] until [the] day of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus; \v 7 just as it is right for me to think this about all of you, because I have you in [my] heart, since both in my chains and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel all of you are fellow sharers with me of the grace.
en.B: Each time I remember you, I give thanks to my God. \v 4 In every prayer I offer for all of you, I always pray with joy, \v 5 because from the very first day until now you have been partners with me in the gospel. \v 6 Of this I am convinced: the one who started a good work in you will keep working at it until it is finished on the day of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. \v 7 It is only right for me to think this way about all of you, because I hold you in my heart. All of you are partners with me in God's grace, both in my chains and as I defend the gospel and show that it stands firm.
en.R: Every time I think of you, I thank my God. \v 4 And whenever I pray for all of you, I pray with joy, \v 5 because you have worked with me to spread the good news, from the first day you believed until now. \v 6 I am sure of this: God began a good work in you, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will keep at it until it is complete on the day {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus comes back. \v 7 It is right that I think of all of you like this, because you have a place in my heart. All of you share God's grace with me, both while I am a prisoner and while I defend the good news and show that it is true.

fr.L: Je rends grâce à mon Dieu à chaque souvenir [que j’ai] de vous, \v 4 toujours, dans chacune de mes prières pour vous tous, faisant cette prière avec joie, \v 5 à cause de votre participation à l’Évangile depuis le premier jour jusqu’à maintenant, \v 6 étant persuadé de ceci même : celui qui a commencé en vous une œuvre bonne [la] mènera à son terme jusqu’au jour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus ; \v 7 comme il est juste pour moi de penser cela de vous tous, parce que je vous ai dans [mon] cœur, puisque, dans mes chaînes comme dans la défense et la confirmation de l’Évangile, vous êtes tous participants avec moi de la grâce.
fr.B: Chaque fois que je me souviens de vous, je rends grâce à mon Dieu. \v 4 Dans chacune des prières que je fais pour vous tous, c’est toujours avec joie que je prie, \v 5 car depuis le tout premier jour jusqu’à maintenant, vous avez été mes partenaires dans l’Évangile. \v 6 J’en suis convaincu : celui qui a commencé en vous une œuvre bonne continuera de la mener jusqu’à son achèvement, au jour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus. \v 7 Il est bien juste que je pense ainsi de vous tous, car je vous porte dans mon cœur. Vous êtes tous mes partenaires dans la grâce de Dieu, aussi bien dans mes chaînes que lorsque je défends l’Évangile et montre qu’il est solide.
fr.R: Chaque fois que je pense à vous, je remercie mon Dieu. \v 4 Et chaque fois que je prie pour vous tous, je prie avec joie, \v 5 parce que vous avez travaillé avec moi pour répandre la bonne nouvelle, depuis le premier jour où vous avez cru jusqu’à maintenant. \v 6 J’en suis sûr : Dieu a commencé à faire en vous quelque chose de bon, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} va continuer jusqu’à ce que ce soit terminé, le jour où le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus reviendra. \v 7 C’est normal que je pense ainsi à vous tous, parce que vous avez une place dans mon cœur. Vous avez tous part avec moi à la grâce de Dieu, quand je suis en prison et quand je défends la bonne nouvelle et montre qu’elle est vraie.

es.L: Doy gracias a mi Dios cada vez que me acuerdo de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, \v 4 siempre, en cada oración mía por todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, haciendo la oración con gozo, \v 5 por {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} participación en el evangelio desde el primer día hasta ahora, \v 6 estando convencido de esto mismo: que el que comenzó en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} una buena obra la completará hasta [el] día de {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús; \v 7 así como es justo que yo piense esto de todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, porque {{plural_you:los|os}} tengo en [mi] corazón, ya que tanto en mis cadenas como en la defensa y confirmación del evangelio todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:son|sois}} copartícipes conmigo de la gracia.
es.B: Cada vez que me acuerdo de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, doy gracias a mi Dios. \v 4 En cada oración que hago por todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, siempre oro con alegría, \v 5 porque desde el primer día hasta ahora {{plural_you:han|habéis}} sido mis compañeros en el evangelio. \v 6 De esto estoy convencido: el que comenzó en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} una buena obra la seguirá realizando hasta completarla en el día {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús. \v 7 Es justo que yo piense así de todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, porque {{plural_you:los|os}} llevo en el corazón. Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:comparten|compartís}} conmigo la gracia de Dios, tanto en mis cadenas como cuando defiendo el evangelio y muestro que se mantiene firme.
es.R: Cada vez que pienso en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, doy gracias a mi Dios. \v 4 Y siempre que oro por todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, lo hago con alegría, \v 5 porque {{plural_you:han|habéis}} trabajado conmigo para anunciar la buena noticia desde el primer día en que {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}} hasta ahora. \v 6 Estoy seguro de esto: Dios comenzó una buena obra en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la seguirá haciendo hasta terminarla el día en que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús vuelva. \v 7 Es justo que piense así de todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, porque {{plural_you:los|os}} llevo en el corazón. Todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:comparten|compartís}} conmigo la gracia de Dios, tanto ahora que estoy preso como cuando defiendo la buena noticia y muestro que es verdad.

sw.L: Ninamshukuru Mungu wangu kila ninapowakumbuka, \v 4 siku zote katika kila ombi langu kwa ajili yenu nyote, nikiomba kwa furaha, \v 5 kwa sababu ya ushirika wenu kwa ajili ya Injili tangu siku ya kwanza mpaka sasa, \v 6 nikiwa na hakika ya jambo hili hili, kwamba aliyeanza kazi njema ndani yenu ataikamilisha mpaka siku ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu; \v 7 kama ilivyo sawa kwangu kufikiri hivi kuhusu ninyi nyote, kwa sababu ninyi mko moyoni [mwangu], kwa kuwa katika minyororo yangu na katika kuitetea na kuithibitisha Injili, ninyi nyote ni washiriki pamoja nami wa neema.
sw.B: Kila ninapowakumbuka, ninamshukuru Mungu wangu. \v 4 Katika kila ombi ninaloomba kwa ajili yenu nyote, siku zote ninaomba kwa furaha, \v 5 kwa sababu tangu siku ya kwanza mpaka sasa mmeshirikiana nami katika kazi ya Injili. \v 6 Nina hakika na jambo hili: aliyeanza kazi njema ndani yenu ataendelea nayo mpaka aikamilishe siku ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. \v 7 Ni sawa kwangu kuwafikiria ninyi nyote hivi, kwa sababu mko moyoni mwangu. Ninyi nyote mnashiriki pamoja nami neema ya Mungu, nikiwa katika minyororo yangu na ninapoitetea Injili na kuonyesha kwamba ni imara.
sw.R: Kila ninapowafikiria, ninamshukuru Mungu wangu. \v 4 Na kila ninapowaombea ninyi nyote, ninaomba kwa furaha, \v 5 kwa sababu mmefanya kazi pamoja nami kueneza Habari Njema, tangu siku ya kwanza mlipoamini mpaka sasa. \v 6 Nina hakika na jambo hili: Mungu alianza kazi njema ndani yenu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ataendelea nayo mpaka itakapokamilika siku ile {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu atakaporudi. \v 7 Ni sawa kwangu kuwafikiria ninyi nyote hivi, kwa sababu mna nafasi moyoni mwangu. Ninyi nyote mnashiriki neema ya Mungu pamoja nami, ninapokuwa mfungwa na ninapoitetea Habari Njema na kuonyesha kwamba ni ya kweli.

ko.L: 나는 여러분을 기억할 때마다 나의 하나님께 감사드립니다. \v 4 여러분 모두를 위하여 드리는 나의 모든 기도에서 언제나 기쁨으로 간구합니다. \v 5 여러분이 첫날부터 지금까지 복음 안에서 [나와] 함께 참여해 왔기 때문입니다. \v 6 나는 바로 이것을 확신합니다. 여러분 안에서 선한 일을 시작하신 분께서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수의 날까지 그것을 완성하실 것입니다. \v 7 내가 여러분 모두에 대하여 이렇게 생각하는 것은 마땅합니다. 내가 여러분을 마음에 품고 있기 때문이며, 내가 매여 있을 때나 복음을 변호하고 확증할 때나 여러분 모두가 나와 함께 은혜에 참여한 사람들이기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 나는 여러분을 기억할 때마다 나의 하나님께 감사드립니다. \v 4 여러분 모두를 위해 기도할 때마다 나는 언제나 기쁨으로 기도합니다. \v 5 여러분이 첫날부터 지금까지 복음을 위해 나와 함께 동역해 왔기 때문입니다. \v 6 나는 이것을 확신합니다. 여러분 안에서 선한 일을 시작하신 분께서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수의 날에 그 일이 완성될 때까지 계속 이루어 가실 것입니다. \v 7 내가 여러분 모두를 이렇게 생각하는 것은 마땅합니다. 내가 여러분을 마음에 품고 있기 때문입니다. 내가 사슬에 매여 있을 때나 복음을 변호하며 그것이 굳건하다는 것을 보여 줄 때나, 여러분은 모두 하나님의 은혜에 나와 함께 참여한 동역자들입니다.
ko.R: 나는 여러분을 생각할 때마다 나의 하나님께 감사드립니다. \v 4 그리고 여러분 모두를 위해 기도할 때마다 기쁨으로 기도합니다. \v 5 여러분이 처음 믿은 날부터 지금까지 기쁜 소식을 전하는 일에 나와 함께 일해 왔기 때문입니다. \v 6 나는 이것을 확신합니다. 하나님께서 여러분 안에서 선한 일을 시작하셨으니, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께서 다시 오시는 날에 그 일이 다 이루어질 때까지 계속하실 것입니다. \v 7 내가 여러분 모두를 이렇게 생각하는 것은 옳습니다. 여러분이 내 마음속에 자리 잡고 있기 때문입니다. 내가 갇혀 있는 동안에도, 그리고 기쁜 소식을 변호하며 그것이 참되다는 것을 보여 주는 동안에도, 여러분은 모두 하나님의 은혜를 나와 함께 나누고 있습니다.

vi.L: Tôi tạ ơn Đức Chúa Trời của tôi mỗi khi nhớ đến anh chị em, \v 4 luôn luôn trong mọi lời cầu nguyện của tôi cho tất cả anh chị em, tôi cầu nguyện với niềm vui, \v 5 vì sự đồng công của anh chị em trong Tin Lành từ ngày đầu tiên cho đến bây giờ, \v 6 vì tôi tin chắc điều này: Đấng đã bắt đầu việc lành trong anh chị em sẽ làm trọn việc ấy cho đến ngày của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu; \v 7 cũng như tôi nghĩ như vậy về tất cả anh chị em là điều phải, vì tôi giữ anh chị em trong lòng, vì cả khi tôi bị xiềng xích lẫn khi tôi bênh vực và xác nhận Tin Lành, tất cả anh chị em đều là những người cùng dự phần ân điển với tôi.
vi.B: Mỗi khi nhớ đến anh chị em, tôi tạ ơn Đức Chúa Trời của tôi. \v 4 Trong mọi lời cầu nguyện cho tất cả anh chị em, tôi luôn luôn cầu nguyện với niềm vui, \v 5 vì từ ngày đầu tiên cho đến bây giờ, anh chị em đã đồng công với tôi trong Tin Lành. \v 6 Tôi tin chắc điều này: Đấng đã bắt đầu một việc lành trong anh chị em sẽ tiếp tục làm cho đến khi hoàn tất vào ngày của Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. \v 7 Tôi nghĩ như vậy về tất cả anh chị em là điều đúng, vì tôi giữ anh chị em trong lòng. Tất cả anh chị em đều cùng dự phần ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời với tôi, cả khi tôi bị xiềng xích lẫn khi tôi bênh vực Tin Lành và chứng tỏ Tin Lành là vững chắc.
vi.R: Mỗi lần nghĩ đến anh chị em, tôi cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời của tôi. \v 4 Và mỗi khi cầu nguyện cho tất cả anh chị em, tôi cầu nguyện với niềm vui, \v 5 vì anh chị em đã cùng làm việc với tôi để truyền bá Tin Lành, từ ngày đầu tiên anh chị em tin cho đến bây giờ. \v 6 Tôi chắc chắn điều này: Đức Chúa Trời đã bắt đầu một việc lành trong anh chị em, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ tiếp tục làm cho đến khi việc ấy hoàn tất vào ngày Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} trở lại. \v 7 Tôi nghĩ về tất cả anh chị em như vậy là điều đúng, vì anh chị em có một chỗ trong lòng tôi. Tất cả anh chị em đều cùng chia sẻ ân điển của Đức Chúa Trời với tôi, cả khi tôi đang ở tù lẫn khi tôi bênh vực Tin Lành và chứng tỏ Tin Lành là thật.

pt.L: Agradeço ao meu Deus a cada lembrança de vocês, \v 4 sempre, em toda oração minha por todos vocês, fazendo a oração com alegria, \v 5 por causa da participação de vocês no evangelho, desde o primeiro dia até agora, \v 6 estando convencido disto mesmo: que aquele que começou em vocês uma boa obra [a] completará até [o] dia {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} Jesus; \v 7 assim como é justo para mim pensar isto a respeito de todos vocês, porque eu os tenho no coração, pois, tanto nas minhas correntes como na defesa e confirmação do evangelho, todos vocês são coparticipantes comigo da graça.
pt.B: Cada vez que me lembro de vocês, dou graças ao meu Deus. \v 4 Em todas as orações que faço por todos vocês, oro sempre com alegria, \v 5 porque, desde o primeiro dia até agora, vocês têm sido meus parceiros no evangelho. \v 6 Disto estou convencido: aquele que começou uma boa obra em vocês vai levá-la adiante até completá-la no dia {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} Jesus. \v 7 É justo que eu pense assim a respeito de todos vocês, porque eu os trago no coração. Todos vocês são meus parceiros na graça de Deus, tanto nas minhas correntes como quando defendo o evangelho e mostro que ele é firme.
pt.R: Toda vez que penso em vocês, agradeço ao meu Deus. \v 4 E sempre que oro por todos vocês, oro com alegria, \v 5 porque vocês trabalharam comigo para espalhar as boas-novas, desde o primeiro dia em que creram até agora. \v 6 Tenho certeza disto: Deus começou uma boa obra em vocês, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai continuar até terminá-la no dia em que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus voltar. \v 7 É certo que eu pense assim de todos vocês, porque vocês têm um lugar no meu coração. Todos vocês compartilham comigo a graça de Deus, tanto enquanto estou preso como enquanto defendo as boas-novas e mostro que elas são verdadeiras.

decisions.choice: verses 3-7 are one sentence
alternatives: verse 7 begins a new sentence, as the SBLGNT's raised dot allows
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT puts a raised dot at the end of verse 6, but verse 7 opens with καθώς ("just as") and gives the ground for the confidence of verse 6, so it cannot stand on its own. The record keeps verses 3-7 together; the meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: every time Paul remembers them
alternatives: for every remembrance of me you have shown (for example, your gifts)
decisions.reason: μνείᾳ with ὑμῶν could mean the Philippians' remembering of Paul, which would fit their gifts in 4:10-18. But in Paul's prayer reports the same kind of phrase means his remembering of others (Romans 1:9; 1 Thessalonians 1:2), and verse 4 goes on to his own prayers.

decisions.choice: active partnership in the work of the gospel
decisions.reason: κοινωνίᾳ means having a share in something together. With εἰς ("for, toward") the gospel it is a shared work: the Philippians took part in Paul's mission with prayer, people and money (4:14-16). Verse 7 picks the idea up again with "fellow sharers".

decisions.choice: from the day the church at Philippi began
decisions.reason: Acts 16:12-40 tells how Paul first preached at Philippi and how Lydia and the jailer's family believed. Philippians 4:15 says they shared in his work from that first time on.

decisions.choice: God, who began his saving work in them, will finish it
decisions.reason: The one who began is not named, but only God can be meant (compare 2:13). The "good work" is his work in them, which includes their partnership in verse 5 but is wider: Paul is sure God will not leave it half done. ὑμῖν is plural and may also mean "among you".

decisions.choice: the day Christ returns as judge and savior
decisions.reason: The prophets spoke of "the day of the Lord" (Amos 5:18; Joel 2:31). Paul applies it to Christ Jesus, whose coming he awaits (1:10; 2:16; 3:20).

decisions.choice: to think and feel this way: a settled attitude
decisions.reason: φρονέω is a key word of the letter (2:2, 2:5, 4:2): a whole way of thinking that includes affection.

decisions.choice: Paul holds the Philippians in his heart
alternatives: the Philippians hold Paul in their heart
decisions.reason: The Greek has two accusatives with the infinitive, με (me) and ὑμᾶς (you), and either can be the subject: "because I have you in my heart" or "because you have me in your heart". We read με as the subject because it stands first and because verse 8 goes on to Paul's own longing for them. The other reading fits their loyalty to him and is fully possible.

decisions.choice: legal words: defending the gospel in court and confirming it
decisions.reason: ἀπολογίᾳ is a defense speech before a judge, and βεβαιώσει the legal confirming of something as valid. Paul is awaiting trial (1:13, 1:16), and he treats his case as the gospel's case.

decisions.choice: a share with Paul in God's grace, including the grace to suffer
alternatives: a share in the privilege of Paul's ministry
decisions.reason: The article points to a particular grace: God's favor that called Paul to his work and keeps him in it, chains and all. In 1:29 suffering for Christ is called something "granted" by grace.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: partners with me (B); worked with me (R)
decisions.reason: The partnership is with Paul, as 4:15 says ("shared with me") and as verse 7 makes explicit; Balanced and Readable name him. Balanced also echoes the word in verse 7 ("partners with me in God's grace").

decisions.choice: the first day you believed; God ... {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}; the day Christ Jesus comes back
decisions.reason: Readable names what the Greek implies: the day they first believed, God as the one at work, and the day of Christ's return.

decisions.choice: while I am a prisoner
decisions.reason: Paul's chains stand for his imprisonment; Readable says so.

decisions.choice: passé composé for past events at every level (for the whole letter)
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Philippians is a letter: Paul speaks to the readers about what they have done and seen ("vous avez été mes partenaires", "vous avez cru"), and French uses the passé composé for that, as in Colossians. Even Paul's own story in 3:4-14 is told to them, not narrated.

decisions.choice: l’Évangile (L, B); la bonne nouvelle (R) (for the whole book)
alternatives: la bonne nouvelle at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and Colossians: Readable says "good news" because "Évangile" is church language; the capital marks the message itself.

decisions.choice: gozo (L); alegría (B, R); participación (L); compañeros (B)
decisions.reason: As in Philippians 4:1, Literal says "gozo" and Balanced and Readable the everyday "alegría"; both render the same word, the letter's key word for joy. For the partnership of verse 5, "comunión" would now be heard as the Lord's Supper or a feeling of closeness; Literal says "participación" and Balanced "compañeros", the active sharing in the work that meaning decision m3 describes.

decisions.choice: Injili (L, B); Habari Njema (R)
decisions.reason: As in the other Swahili letters: "Injili" names the message in Literal and Balanced, and Readable says "Habari Njema" (the good news), capitalised as in Colossians and Romans. Used through the whole letter.

decisions.choice: ni sawa (it is right)
decisions.reason: "Haki" is kept for righteousness in Swahili (style guide, section 5), so "it is right for me" is "ni sawa kwangu".

decisions.choice: Literal breaks the one Greek sentence of verses 3-7 into a sentence for each verse
decisions.reason: Korean puts the main verb at the end, so one sentence would move "I thank my God" from verse 3 to the end of verse 7. Literal keeps each verse's content after its marker and the Greek's clauses in their order.

decisions.choice: "동역하다", "동역자" for the partnership (B); "함께 참여하다" (L); "함께 일하다" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is active partnership in the work of the gospel (the meaning decision). "동역" (working together) says that in church Korean; Literal keeps the root "참여" (share in), which links with "fellow sharers" in verse 7; "교제" in everyday Korean usually means dating.

decisions.choice: "sự đồng công" (L), "đồng công" (B); "cùng làm việc" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is active partnership in the work of the gospel (m3). "Thông công" (fellowship) is kept for sharing a common life, as in Galatians 2:9; "đồng công" says working together, which is the sense here.

decisions.choice: "ngày của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu" (L, B); "ngày Đức Giê-xu ... trở lại" (R)
decisions.reason: The day Christ returns (m6); Readable says so, as the English Readable does (also 1:10; 2:16).

decisions.choice: o evangelho (L, B); as boas-novas (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as Romans and docs/portuguese-style.md section 6 have it: "evangelho" is the word Brazilian readers know for the message, kept as the English keeps "gospel"; Readable says "as boas-novas", as the English Readable says "good news".

decisions.choice: participação, coparticipantes (L); parceiros (B)
decisions.reason: "Comunhão" in church use suggests fellowship or the Lord's Supper, while m3 means an active share in the work of the gospel. Literal says "participação" and "coparticipantes" to keep the two related words; Balanced says "parceiros" in both verses, as the English says "partners".

source.text: μάρτυς γάρ μου ὁ θεός, ὡς ἐπιποθῶ πάντας ὑμᾶς ἐν σπλάγχνοις Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Witness for of me [is] the God, how I long for all you in [the] inner parts of Christ Jesus.

en.L: For God [is] my witness, how I long for all of you in [the] tender affection of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus.
en.B: God is my witness how much I long for every one of you with the deep love of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.
en.R: God knows how much I long to see all of you. I love you with the tender love of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}.

fr.L: Car Dieu [est] mon témoin, combien je languis après vous tous dans la tendresse du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus.
fr.B: Dieu m’est témoin combien vous me manquez, chacun de vous, et combien je vous aime de l’amour profond du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus.
fr.R: Dieu sait combien j’ai envie de vous revoir tous. Je vous aime avec la tendresse du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}.

es.L: Porque Dios [es] mi testigo de cómo {{plural_you:los|os}} añoro a todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} en [las] entrañas de {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús.
es.B: Dios es testigo de cuánto {{plural_you:los|os}} añoro a todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con el amor entrañable {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús.
es.R: Dios sabe cuánto deseo {{plural_you:verlos|veros}} a todos. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} amo con el mismo amor tierno que tiene {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús.

sw.L: Kwa maana Mungu ni shahidi wangu, jinsi ninavyowaonea shauku ninyi nyote katika moyo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.B: Mungu ni shahidi wangu jinsi ninavyomwonea shauku kila mmoja wenu kwa upendo mwororo wa moyo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.R: Mungu anajua jinsi ninavyotamani sana kuwaona ninyi nyote. Ninawapenda kwa upendo mwororo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.

ko.L: 내가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수의 심정으로 여러분 모두를 얼마나 그리워하는지 하나님께서 나의 증인이십니다.
ko.B: 내가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수의 깊은 사랑으로 여러분 모두를 얼마나 그리워하는지 하나님께서 증언해 주십니다.
ko.R: 내가 여러분 모두를 얼마나 보고 싶어 하는지 하나님께서 아십니다. 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께서 주시는 따뜻한 사랑으로 여러분을 사랑합니다.

vi.L: Vì Đức Chúa Trời là chứng nhân cho tôi, rằng tôi mong mỏi tất cả anh chị em với lòng thương yêu tha thiết của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu thể nào.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời làm chứng cho tôi rằng tôi mong mỏi từng người trong anh chị em biết bao, với tình yêu sâu xa của Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời biết tôi mong được gặp tất cả anh chị em biết bao. Tôi yêu thương anh chị em bằng chính tình yêu dịu dàng của Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.

pt.L: Pois Deus [é] minha testemunha de como anseio por todos vocês no terno afeto {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} Jesus.
pt.B: Deus é minha testemunha de quanta saudade tenho de cada um de vocês, com o profundo amor {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} Jesus.
pt.R: Deus sabe quanta saudade eu tenho de vocês e quanto quero vê-los. Eu amo vocês com o terno amor do próprio {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} Jesus.

decisions.choice: a solemn oath: God can confirm it
alternatives: a general remark that God sees everything
decisions.reason: Paul calls God as witness when he wants to assure readers he is telling the truth about something they cannot see, such as his prayers or his feelings (Romans 1:9; 1 Thessalonians 2:5).

decisions.choice: deep affection, felt in the inner being
decisions.reason: σπλάγχνοις literally means the inner organs, which Greek speakers treated as the seat of strong feeling, much as we speak of the heart.

decisions.choice: Christ's own affection, at work in Paul
decisions.reason: Paul does not love them merely with his own feelings: the tender love of Christ Jesus moves in him (compare Galatians 2:20).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: God knows how much ...; long to see
decisions.reason: Readable gives the force of the oath in plain words, and says what the longing is for: to be with them again (compare 2:26 and 4:1).

decisions.choice: every French pronoun for God or Christ carries the deity_pronoun span, subject "il" included (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians: French must write the subject pronoun, so "il" for God or Christ carries the span wherever the English "he" does (1:6 at Readable), and so do lui, le, l’, son, sa, ses and lui-même. A pronoun at the start of a sentence is written plainly with its capital.

decisions.choice: vous me manquez (B)
decisions.reason: "Je vous désire" would carry the wrong overtones in French, and "soupirer après" is old-fashioned outside Literal. "Vous me manquez" says the longing to be with them plainly.

decisions.choice: entrañas (L); amor entrañable (B); amor tierno (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word names the inner organs as the seat of deep feeling (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps "entrañas", which Spanish still uses that way; Balanced says "amor entrañable", the ordinary Spanish phrase for heartfelt love that keeps the same root; Readable says "amor tierno". In Readable "Jesús mismo" is not needed: "el mismo amor que tiene" says it is Christ's own love.

decisions.choice: moyo (L); upendo mwororo wa moyo (B)
decisions.reason: Swahili places deep affection in the heart, not in the inward parts, so Literal says "moyo" (heart) for splanchna, as the project's NT terms list, and Balanced spells out the tender love it holds (m2).

decisions.choice: "심정" (L); "깊은 사랑" (B); "따뜻한 사랑" (R)
decisions.reason: The word names the inner parts as the seat of deep feeling (the meaning decision). Korean "심정" (one's inmost heart and feelings) keeps the sense of what is felt within; Balanced and Readable say what the feeling is, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "lòng thương yêu tha thiết" (L); "tình yêu sâu xa" (B); "tình yêu dịu dàng" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the inner parts, the seat of deep affection (m2). Vietnamese speaks of feeling in "lòng" (the heart) rather than the bowels, so Literal says "lòng thương yêu tha thiết"; "ruột gan" would sound comic.

decisions.choice: quanta saudade tenho de (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Ter saudade de" is the Portuguese word for longing for someone who is far away, which is what Paul feels; Literal keeps "anseio por".

decisions.choice: do próprio {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} Jesus
decisions.reason: Portuguese puts the English "himself" before the name as "próprio", which is an adjective, not a pronoun, so this level has no deity_pronoun span where the English has one.

source.text: καὶ τοῦτο προσεύχομαι ἵνα ἡ ἀγάπη ὑμῶν ἔτι μᾶλλον καὶ μᾶλλον περισσεύῃ ἐν ἐπιγνώσει καὶ πάσῃ αἰσθήσει, εἰς τὸ δοκιμάζειν ὑμᾶς τὰ διαφέροντα, ἵνα ἦτε εἰλικρινεῖς καὶ ἀπρόσκοποι εἰς ἡμέραν Χριστοῦ, πεπληρωμένοι καρπὸν δικαιοσύνης τὸν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς δόξαν καὶ ἔπαινον θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And this I pray, that the love of you yet more and more may abound in knowledge and all discernment, \v 10 for the to test you the things excelling, so that you may be pure and without stumbling for [the] day of Christ, \v 11 having been filled [with the] fruit of righteousness, the [one] through Jesus Christ, to glory and praise of God.

en.L: And this I pray, that your love may overflow yet more and more in full knowledge and every [kind of] insight, \v 10 so that you test and approve the things that matter, so that you may be pure and without stumbling for [the] day of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 11 filled with [the] fruit of righteousness which [is] through Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, to [the] glory and praise of God.
en.B: And this is what I pray: that your love will overflow more and more, with full knowledge and every kind of insight, \v 10 so that you can test and recognize what really matters. Then on the day of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} you will be pure and free from stumbling, \v 11 full of the fruit of righteousness that is produced through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, so that God receives glory and praise.
en.R: Here is what I pray for you. I pray that your love will keep growing more and more, along with real knowledge and good sense. \v 10 Then you will be able to see what is truly best. You will be pure, and nothing will make you fall, when {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} comes back. \v 11 Your lives will be full of the fruit of a righteous life, which Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} produces in you. All this will bring glory and praise to God.

fr.L: Et ceci, je le demande en priant : que votre amour abonde encore de plus en plus en pleine connaissance et en tout discernement, \v 10 pour que vous éprouviez les choses qui importent, afin que vous soyez purs et sans faux pas pour le jour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, \v 11 remplis du fruit de justice qui [vient] par Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, pour la gloire et la louange de Dieu.
fr.B: Et voici ce que je demande dans ma prière : que votre amour déborde de plus en plus, avec une pleine connaissance et toute forme de discernement, \v 10 afin que vous puissiez éprouver et reconnaître ce qui compte vraiment. Alors, au jour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, vous serez purs et sans faux pas, \v 11 remplis du fruit de la justice que produit Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, pour que Dieu reçoive gloire et louange.
fr.R: Voici ce que je demande pour vous dans ma prière. Je prie pour que votre amour continue à grandir de plus en plus, avec une vraie connaissance et du bon sens. \v 10 Alors vous serez capables de voir ce qui est vraiment le meilleur. Vous serez purs, et rien ne vous fera tomber, quand le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} reviendra. \v 11 Votre vie sera pleine du fruit d’une vie juste, que Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} produit en vous. Ainsi, Dieu recevra gloire et louange.

es.L: Y esto oro: que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} amor abunde aún más y más en pleno conocimiento y en todo discernimiento, \v 10 para que {{plural_you:examinen y aprueben|examinéis y aprobéis}} lo que importa, a fin de que {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} puros y sin tropiezo para [el] día de {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, \v 11 llenos [del] fruto de justicia que [es] por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, para gloria y alabanza de Dios.
es.B: Y esto es lo que pido en oración: que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} amor abunde cada vez más, con pleno conocimiento y toda clase de discernimiento, \v 10 para que {{plural_you:puedan|podáis}} examinar y reconocer lo que de verdad importa. Así, en el día {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} puros y libres de tropiezo, \v 11 llenos del fruto de justicia que se produce por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, para que Dios reciba gloria y alabanza.
es.R: Esto es lo que pido para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: que {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} amor siga creciendo más y más, junto con un conocimiento verdadero y buen juicio. \v 10 Así {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} ver qué es de verdad lo mejor. {{plural_you:Serán|Seréis}} puros, y nada {{plural_you:los|os}} hará caer cuando {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} vuelva. \v 11 {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestras}} vidas estarán llenas del fruto de una vida justa, que {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} produce en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Todo esto dará gloria y alabanza a Dios.

sw.L: Na hili ndilo ninaloomba: kwamba upendo wenu uzidi kuongezeka zaidi na zaidi katika ujuzi na utambuzi wote, \v 10 ili mpate kupima na kuyakubali mambo yaliyo bora, ili mwe safi na bila kujikwaa kwa ajili ya siku ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 11 mkiwa mmejazwa tunda la haki lililo kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, kwa utukufu na sifa ya Mungu.
sw.B: Na hili ndilo ninaloomba: kwamba upendo wenu uzidi kufurika zaidi na zaidi, pamoja na ujuzi kamili na utambuzi wa kila aina, \v 10 ili mweze kupima na kutambua mambo yaliyo ya maana kweli. Hapo siku ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} mtakuwa safi na bila kujikwaa, \v 11 mkiwa mmejaa tunda la haki linalozaliwa kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ili Mungu apate utukufu na sifa.
sw.R: Hiki ndicho ninachowaombea: kwamba upendo wenu uendelee kukua zaidi na zaidi, pamoja na ujuzi wa kweli na busara. \v 10 Hapo mtaweza kutambua lililo bora kabisa. Mtakuwa safi, na hakuna kitakachowaangusha, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} atakaporudi. \v 11 Maisha yenu yatajaa tunda la maisha ya haki, ambalo Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} huzaa ndani yenu. Haya yote yataleta utukufu na sifa kwa Mungu.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 기도하는 것은 이것입니다. 여러분의 사랑이 온전한 지식과 모든 분별력 안에서 더욱더 넘치게 하시고, \v 10 여러분이 가장 중요한 것들을 분별하여, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 날까지 순결하고 걸려 넘어지지 않으며, \v 11 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여 [오는] 의의 열매로 가득 차서 하나님의 영광과 찬송이 되게 하시기를 [기도합니다].
ko.B: 내가 기도하는 것은 이것입니다. 여러분의 사랑이 온전한 지식과 모든 통찰력으로 더욱더 넘쳐서, \v 10 여러분이 정말 중요한 것을 가려낼 수 있게 되기를 기도합니다. 그러면 여러분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 날에 순결하고 걸려 넘어질 것이 없을 것입니다. \v 11 그리고 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 맺히는 의의 열매로 가득 차서, 하나님께서 영광과 찬송을 받으시게 될 것입니다.
ko.R: 나는 여러분을 위해 이렇게 기도합니다. 여러분의 사랑이 참된 지식과 바른 판단력과 함께 점점 더 자라기를 기도합니다. \v 10 그러면 여러분은 무엇이 정말 가장 좋은 것인지 알아볼 수 있을 것입니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 다시 오실 때, 여러분은 깨끗하고, 아무것도 여러분을 넘어뜨리지 못할 것입니다. \v 11 여러분의 삶은 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분 안에 맺으시는 의로운 삶의 열매로 가득할 것입니다. 이 모든 것이 하나님께 영광과 찬송을 돌리게 할 것입니다.

vi.L: Và tôi cầu nguyện điều này, là tình yêu thương của anh chị em ngày càng chan chứa hơn nữa trong sự hiểu biết và mọi sự sáng suốt, \v 10 để anh chị em thử nghiệm và chọn lấy những điều quan trọng, hầu cho anh chị em được trong sạch và không vấp ngã cho đến ngày của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, \v 11 được đầy dẫy trái của sự công chính đến qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, để làm vinh hiển và ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Và đây là điều tôi cầu nguyện: xin cho tình yêu thương của anh chị em ngày càng chan chứa, với sự hiểu biết đầy đủ và mọi sự sáng suốt, \v 10 để anh chị em có thể thử nghiệm và nhận ra những gì thật sự quan trọng. Khi đó, vào ngày của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, anh chị em sẽ trong sạch và không vấp ngã, \v 11 đầy dẫy trái của sự công chính mà Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} sinh ra, để Đức Chúa Trời được vinh hiển và ca ngợi.
vi.R: Đây là điều tôi cầu nguyện cho anh chị em. Tôi cầu nguyện cho tình yêu thương của anh chị em cứ ngày càng lớn lên, cùng với sự hiểu biết thật và sự khôn ngoan biết phân biệt. \v 10 Khi đó anh chị em sẽ có thể thấy điều gì là tốt nhất. Anh chị em sẽ được trong sạch, và không điều gì làm anh chị em vấp ngã, khi {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} trở lại. \v 11 Đời sống anh chị em sẽ đầy dẫy trái của một đời sống công chính, là trái mà Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} sinh ra trong anh chị em. Tất cả điều đó sẽ đem vinh hiển và lời ca ngợi đến cho Đức Chúa Trời.

pt.L: E isto eu oro: que o amor de vocês transborde ainda mais e mais em pleno conhecimento e em todo [tipo de] discernimento, \v 10 para que vocês ponham à prova e aprovem as coisas que importam, a fim de que sejam puros e sem tropeço para [o] dia {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, \v 11 cheios [do] fruto de justiça que [vem] por meio de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, para [a] glória e [o] louvor de Deus.
pt.B: E é isto que eu peço em oração: que o amor de vocês transborde cada vez mais, com pleno conhecimento e todo tipo de discernimento, \v 10 para que vocês possam examinar e reconhecer o que realmente importa. Então, no dia {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, vocês estarão puros e livres de tropeço, \v 11 cheios do fruto de justiça que é produzido por meio de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, para que Deus receba glória e louvor.
pt.R: Isto é o que eu peço a Deus por vocês. Peço que o amor de vocês continue crescendo cada vez mais, junto com um conhecimento verdadeiro e bom senso. \v 10 Assim vocês vão ser capazes de ver o que é realmente melhor. Vocês vão estar puros, e nada vai fazer vocês caírem quando {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} voltar. \v 11 A vida de vocês vai estar cheia do fruto de uma vida justa, que Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} produz em vocês. Tudo isso vai trazer glória e louvor a Deus.

decisions.choice: full knowledge and moral insight
decisions.reason: ἐπιγνώσει is real, growing knowledge, especially of God and his will (Colossians 1:9). αἰσθήσει occurs only here in the New Testament: the practical sense to tell good from bad in a given situation. Paul wants their love to grow together with both.

decisions.choice: to test and so to recognize what really matters
alternatives: to tell apart things that differ
decisions.reason: δοκιμάζειν means to test and then approve; διαφέροντα can mean "things that differ" or "things that excel". The phrase means the ability to sort out what is best, as in Romans 2:18.

decisions.choice: pure, and not stumbling
alternatives: sincere, and giving no offense to others
decisions.reason: εἰλικρινεῖς means unmixed, without hidden motives. ἀπρόσκοποι can mean "not stumbling" or "not causing others to stumble" (1 Corinthians 10:32). Standing before Christ on his day, the first sense, blameless, fits best.

decisions.choice: the day of Christ's return
decisions.reason: As in verse 6: the day of the Lord, now the day of Christ (2:16).

decisions.choice: the harvest of right living that Jesus Christ produces
alternatives: the reward that comes from being declared right with God
decisions.reason: "Fruit of righteousness" is an Old Testament phrase for upright conduct (Proverbs 11:30; Amos 6:12; compare James 3:18). Here it grows "through Jesus Christ": not their own achievement, but what he produces in those he has made right with God (3:9).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: the singular "fruit"
decisions.reason: Some later manuscripts have the plural. The singular is the better-attested reading and the meaning hardly changes.

decisions.choice: the final goal: God's glory and praise
decisions.reason: The whole prayer ends with God receiving glory and praise, as the hymn in 2:11 does.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} / Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: the sentence broken into three (B) or four (R)
decisions.reason: Verses 9-11 are one Greek sentence; Balanced and Readable break it where each clause can stand, keeping its order.

decisions.choice: the fruit of a righteous life
decisions.reason: Readable spells out that the fruit is right living (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: when Christ comes back
decisions.reason: Readable names the event the day refers to.

decisions.choice: la justice (L, B); une vie juste (R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: "La justice" is the term-sheet word for righteousness at Literal and Balanced. Here it is the right living that Christ produces (m5), which Readable says plainly, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: examinar y aprobar (L); examinar y reconocer (B); ver qué es lo mejor (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to test something and so to approve it (meaning decision m2). Spanish needs two verbs to say both; Readable keeps only the result, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "의의 열매" (L, B); "의로운 삶의 열매" (R)
decisions.reason: "의" is the key term for righteousness at every level, as in Romans and Galatians. Here it is right living that Jesus Christ produces (the meaning decision), which Readable says, keeping the root "의".

decisions.choice: "sự công chính" (L, B), "công chính" (R)
decisions.reason: The key term of the style guide and the Vietnamese Romans, at every level; here it is the right living Christ produces (m5), and Readable says "a righteous life" with the same word.

decisions.choice: "vinh hiển" for the glory given to God here
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "vinh quang" for glory as a noun of what God has. "Làm vinh hiển" and "được vinh hiển" are the Vietnamese way of saying that glory is given to God, and keep the same root sense.

decisions.choice: justiça
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as docs/portuguese-style.md section 6 and Romans have it: "justiça" at Literal and Balanced, so that the phrase links with "a justiça que vem de Deus" in 3:9. Readable says "uma vida justa", as the English Readable spells out right living.

source.text: Γινώσκειν δὲ ὑμᾶς βούλομαι, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι τὰ κατ’ ἐμὲ μᾶλλον εἰς προκοπὴν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ἐλήλυθεν, ὥστε τοὺς δεσμούς μου φανεροὺς ἐν Χριστῷ γενέσθαι ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ πραιτωρίῳ καὶ τοῖς λοιποῖς πᾶσιν, καὶ τοὺς πλείονας τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἐν κυρίῳ πεποιθότας τοῖς δεσμοῖς μου περισσοτέρως τολμᾶν ἀφόβως τὸν λόγον λαλεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Now to know you I want, brothers, that the things concerning me rather to [the] advance of the gospel have come, \v 13 so that the chains of me clearly known in Christ to become in the whole praetorium and to the rest all, \v 14 and the most of the brothers in [the] Lord having been persuaded by the chains of me more abundantly to dare fearlessly the word to speak.

en.L: Now I want you to know, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, that the things concerning me have rather come to [the] advance of the gospel, \v 13 so that my chains have become clearly known [as being] in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} in the whole praetorian guard and to all the rest, \v 14 and most of the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, having become confident in [the] Lord by my chains, dare far more to speak the word without fear.
en.B: I want you to understand, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, that what has happened to me has moved the gospel forward rather than holding it back. \v 13 As a result, the whole imperial guard and everyone else here have come to see that I am in chains for the sake of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. \v 14 And my chains have given most of the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} confidence in the Lord, so that they dare to speak the word far more boldly and without fear.
en.R: {{gender:Brothers and sisters|Brothers}}, I want you to know that the things that have happened to me have helped the good news spread even more. \v 13 All the soldiers of the emperor's guard, and everyone else here, now know that I am a prisoner because I serve {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. \v 14 And because I am in chains, most of the {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}} here trust the Lord more. Now they are much braver about telling God's message, and they are not afraid.

fr.L: Or je veux que vous sachiez, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, que ce qui me concerne a plutôt tourné au progrès de l’Évangile, \v 13 de sorte que mes chaînes sont devenues manifestes [comme étant] {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} dans toute la garde prétorienne et auprès de tous les autres, \v 14 et que la plupart des {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, ayant pris confiance dans le Seigneur grâce à mes chaînes, osent bien davantage dire la parole sans crainte.
fr.B: Je veux que vous le compreniez, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} : ce qui m’est arrivé a fait avancer l’Évangile au lieu de le freiner. \v 13 Ainsi, toute la garde impériale et tous les autres ici ont compris que je suis enchaîné pour le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. \v 14 Et mes chaînes ont donné à la plupart des {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} confiance dans le Seigneur, si bien qu’ils osent annoncer la parole avec beaucoup plus d’audace et sans crainte.
fr.R: {{gender:Frères et sœurs|Frères}}, je veux que vous le sachiez : ce qui m’est arrivé a aidé la bonne nouvelle à se répandre encore plus. \v 13 Tous les soldats de la garde de l’empereur, et tous les autres ici, savent maintenant que je suis prisonnier parce que je sers le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. \v 14 Et parce que je suis enchaîné, la plupart des {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} d’ici ont davantage confiance dans le Seigneur. Maintenant, ils ont beaucoup plus de courage pour annoncer le message de Dieu, et ils n’ont pas peur.

es.L: Ahora quiero que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}}, hermanos, que las cosas que me han sucedido han redundado más bien en [el] avance del evangelio, \v 13 de modo que mis cadenas han llegado a ser conocidas [como] en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} en toda la guardia pretoriana y entre todos los demás, \v 14 y la mayoría de los hermanos, habiendo cobrado confianza en [el] Señor por mis cadenas, se atreven mucho más a hablar la palabra sin temor.
es.B: Quiero que {{plural_you:entiendan|entendáis}}, hermanos, que lo que me ha pasado, en lugar de frenar el evangelio, lo ha hecho avanzar. \v 13 Por eso toda la guardia imperial y todos los demás aquí han llegado a ver que estoy encadenado por causa {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. \v 14 Y mis cadenas han dado a la mayoría de los hermanos confianza en el Señor, de modo que se atreven a anunciar la palabra con mucha más valentía y sin miedo.
es.R: Hermanos, quiero que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} que lo que me ha pasado ha ayudado a que la buena noticia se extienda todavía más. \v 13 Todos los soldados de la guardia del emperador, y todos los demás aquí, saben ahora que estoy preso porque sirvo {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}. \v 14 Y como estoy encadenado, la mayoría de los hermanos de aquí confían más en el Señor. Ahora son mucho más valientes para hablar del mensaje de Dios, y no tienen miedo.

sw.L: Basi nataka mjue, ndugu, kwamba mambo yaliyonipata yamekuwa zaidi kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya Injili, \v 13 hivi kwamba minyororo yangu imejulikana wazi kuwa [ni] katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} katika kikosi chote cha walinzi wa kifalme na kwa wengine wote, \v 14 na wengi wa ndugu katika Bwana, wakiwa wamepata uhakika kwa minyororo yangu, wanathubutu zaidi sana kulinena neno bila hofu.
sw.B: Ndugu, nataka mfahamu kwamba yaliyonipata yameisaidia Injili kusonga mbele badala ya kuizuia. \v 13 Matokeo yake ni kwamba kikosi chote cha walinzi wa kifalme na wengine wote hapa wametambua kwamba niko katika minyororo kwa ajili ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 14 Tena minyororo yangu imewapa wengi wa ndugu uhakika katika Bwana, hivi kwamba wanathubutu kulinena neno kwa ujasiri zaidi sana na bila hofu.
sw.R: Ndugu, nataka mjue kwamba mambo yaliyonipata yamesaidia Habari Njema kuenea zaidi. \v 13 Askari wote wa kikosi cha walinzi wa Kaisari, na watu wengine wote hapa, sasa wanajua kwamba mimi ni mfungwa kwa sababu ninamtumikia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 14 Na kwa sababu niko katika minyororo, wengi wa ndugu hapa wanamtumaini Bwana zaidi. Sasa wana ujasiri mwingi zaidi wa kuwaeleza watu ujumbe wa Mungu, wala hawaogopi.

ko.L: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나에게 일어난 일들이 오히려 복음의 진전이 되었다는 것을 여러분이 알기를 원합니다. \v 13 그래서 내가 매인 것이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 [그렇게 된 것]이라는 것이 온 근위대와 그 밖의 모든 사람에게 분명히 알려졌고, \v 14 주님 안에 있는 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들 대부분이 나의 매임으로 확신을 얻어, 두려움 없이 말씀을 더욱 담대하게 전하게 되었습니다.
ko.B: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나에게 일어난 일이 복음을 가로막기는커녕 오히려 앞으로 나아가게 했다는 것을 여러분이 알기를 바랍니다. \v 13 그 결과 온 황제 근위대와 이곳의 다른 모든 사람이, 내가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 때문에 사슬에 매여 있다는 것을 알게 되었습니다. \v 14 그리고 내가 매여 있는 것 때문에 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들 대부분이 주님 안에서 확신을 얻어, 두려움 없이 훨씬 더 담대하게 말씀을 전하고 있습니다.
ko.R: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나에게 일어난 일들이 오히려 기쁜 소식이 더 널리 퍼지게 했다는 것을 여러분이 알기를 바랍니다. \v 13 황제의 근위대 병사들과 이곳의 다른 모든 사람이 이제 내가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 섬기기 때문에 갇혀 있다는 것을 알고 있습니다. \v 14 그리고 내가 사슬에 매여 있기 때문에, 이곳의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들 대부분이 주님을 더욱 신뢰하게 되었습니다. 이제 그들은 훨씬 더 용감하게 하나님의 말씀을 전하고, 두려워하지 않습니다.

vi.L: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi muốn anh chị em biết rằng những việc xảy đến cho tôi lại đã giúp cho Tin Lành được tiến triển, \v 13 đến nỗi cả đội cận vệ và mọi người khác đều thấy rõ rằng tôi bị xiềng xích là vì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, \v 14 và phần đông các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} trong Chúa, nhờ xiềng xích của tôi mà được thêm lòng tin cậy, càng dám nói lời [Đức Chúa Trời] mà không sợ hãi.
vi.B: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi muốn anh chị em hiểu rằng những gì đã xảy ra cho tôi lại giúp cho Tin Lành tiến tới, chứ không cản trở. \v 13 Kết quả là cả đội cận vệ của hoàng đế và mọi người khác ở đây đều đã thấy rằng tôi bị xiềng xích vì {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. \v 14 Và nhờ xiềng xích của tôi, phần đông các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} đã được thêm lòng tin cậy nơi Chúa, đến nỗi họ dám nói lời Đức Chúa Trời cách dạn dĩ hơn nhiều mà không sợ hãi.
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, tôi muốn anh chị em biết rằng những gì đã xảy ra cho tôi lại giúp Tin Lành được lan rộng hơn nữa. \v 13 Tất cả binh lính trong đội cận vệ của hoàng đế, và mọi người khác ở đây, bây giờ đều biết rằng tôi bị tù vì tôi phục vụ {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. \v 14 Và vì tôi bị xiềng xích, phần đông các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} ở đây tin cậy Chúa nhiều hơn. Bây giờ họ dạn dĩ hơn nhiều trong việc nói sứ điệp của Đức Chúa Trời, và họ không sợ hãi.

pt.L: Quero, porém, que vocês saibam, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, que as coisas a meu respeito têm, antes, servido para [o] avanço do evangelho, \v 13 de modo que as minhas correntes se tornaram claramente conhecidas [como sendo] {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} em toda a guarda pretoriana e a todos os demais, \v 14 e a maioria dos {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, tendo ficado confiantes no Senhor por causa das minhas correntes, ousa muito mais falar a palavra sem medo.
pt.B: Quero que vocês entendam, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, que o que me aconteceu fez o evangelho avançar, em vez de detê-lo. \v 13 Por isso toda a guarda imperial e todos os outros aqui ficaram sabendo que estou acorrentado por causa {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}. \v 14 E as minhas correntes deram confiança no Senhor à maioria dos {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, de modo que eles ousam anunciar a palavra com muito mais coragem e sem medo.
pt.R: {{gender:Irmãos e irmãs|Irmãos}}, quero que vocês saibam que as coisas que me aconteceram ajudaram as boas-novas a se espalhar ainda mais. \v 13 Todos os soldados da guarda do imperador, e todos os outros aqui, agora sabem que estou preso porque sirvo {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}. \v 14 E, por eu estar acorrentado, a maioria dos {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}} daqui confia mais no Senhor. Agora eles têm muito mais coragem para falar a mensagem de Deus e não têm medo.

decisions.choice: fellow believers, women and men
decisions.reason: ἀδελφοί addresses the whole church, which includes women such as Lydia (Acts 16:14-15) and Euodia and Syntyche (4:2). The believers in verse 14 are likewise the church at large.

decisions.choice: contrary to what they might fear, his situation has helped
decisions.reason: μᾶλλον here means "rather, instead": the Philippians would expect Paul's arrest to hold the gospel back, but it has moved it forward. προκοπὴν is progress, a pioneer's advance; Paul uses it again of the Philippians' own progress in 1:25.

decisions.choice: the imperial guard: the soldiers who guarded Paul
decisions.reason: πραιτωρίῳ can mean a body of troops, the Praetorian Guard in Rome, or a governor's residence, as in Mark 15:16 and Acts 23:35. "And to all the rest" points to people, which favors the guard. Where Paul was held (Rome, or possibly Ephesus or Caesarea) is not stated in the letter; 4:22 mentions "Caesar's household".

decisions.choice: it has become clear that his chains are for Christ
decisions.reason: ἐν Χριστῷ goes with "clearly known": people now see that Paul is a prisoner because of Christ, not for a crime.

decisions.choice: made confident in the Lord by Paul's chains
alternatives: "brothers in the Lord" as one phrase
decisions.reason: "In the Lord" could go with "brothers", but believers are always brothers in the Lord, so it more likely says where their new confidence rests.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "the word"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts, some of them early, add "of God", and a few "of the Lord". The SBLGNT prints the shorter reading. The meaning is the same: the message about Christ.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: Paul is addressing the whole church, women and men, so the inclusive default spells that out. Traditional is one tap away.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: praetorian guard (L); imperial guard (B)
decisions.reason: "Praetorium" is not English; the guard is the reading chosen (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: because I serve Christ; God's message
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what "in Christ" means for the chains, and what "the word" is.

decisions.choice: {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} for the believers (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians and the English: Paul addresses the whole church, women and men (m1), and "frères" stays available as the traditional form. Words that agree with the noun need no span.

decisions.choice: la garde prétorienne (L); la garde impériale (B)
decisions.reason: "Le prétoire" is a French word, but it names the governor's building; the meaning decision reads the soldiers of the guard (m3), so Literal says "la garde prétorienne".

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in Philippians 4:1, Spanish "hermanos" already covers brothers and sisters, so adding "y hermanas" would add words the Greek does not have. The same throughout the letter.

decisions.choice: guardia pretoriana (L); guardia imperial (B)
decisions.reason: "Pretorio" would make most readers think of a building; the word here means the soldiers who guarded Paul (meaning decision m3). Literal keeps the Latin name of the guard, Balanced says whose guard it was, and Readable explains it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no gender span
alternatives: ndugu wa kiume na wa kike
decisions.reason: As in Romans, Galatians and Colossians: "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so Swahili needs no gender span where the English has one, here and through the letter (also "wanadamu" in 2:7 and "wanadamu wote" in 4:5). A male-only alternative would change the meaning.

decisions.choice: kikosi cha walinzi wa kifalme (L, B); kikosi cha walinzi wa Kaisari (R)
decisions.reason: The praetorium here is the imperial guard, the soldiers who guarded Paul (m3), not a building, so Swahili names the unit: "walinzi wa kifalme" (royal guard). Readable names the emperor, "Kaisari", as 1 Peter 2:13 does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분 for the address and {{gender:형제자매|형제}}들 for the believers, through the letter
decisions.reason: As in Romans and Galatians: "형제자매" is the inclusive default for fellow believers, women and men (the meaning decision), and "형제" the traditional form; "여러분" keeps the respectful address of the letter.

decisions.choice: "근위대" (L); "황제 근위대" (B); "황제의 근위대 병사들" (R)
decisions.reason: The word names the imperial guard, the soldiers who guarded Paul (the meaning decision). "근위대" is the current word; "시위대" is older, and the Latin name means nothing to most readers.

decisions.choice: "thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}" for the address, "các {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}" for the believers spoken of (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: The forms of the Vietnamese Romans (1:13) and Colossians (1:2); adelphoi here are fellow believers, women and men (m1).

decisions.choice: "đội cận vệ" (L), "đội cận vệ của hoàng đế" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is either the imperial guard or the governor's headquarters (m3). The meaning decision reads the soldiers who guarded Paul, as the English does, so Vietnamese names the guard.

source.text: Τινὲς μὲν καὶ διὰ φθόνον καὶ ἔριν, τινὲς δὲ καὶ δι’ εὐδοκίαν τὸν Χριστὸν κηρύσσουσιν·

records.literal_gloss: Some indeed even because of envy and strife, but some also because of goodwill the Christ are proclaiming;

en.L: Some indeed proclaim the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} even from envy and rivalry, but some also from goodwill.
en.B: Some, to be sure, are proclaiming {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} from jealousy and a spirit of rivalry; others do it from goodwill.
en.R: Some people are telling others about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} because they are jealous of me and want to compete with me. But others do it because they want to help.

fr.L: Certains, il est vrai, proclament le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} même par envie et par rivalité, mais d’autres aussi par bienveillance.
fr.B: Certains, c’est vrai, proclament le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} par jalousie et par esprit de rivalité ; d’autres le font par bienveillance.
fr.R: Certains parlent du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} aux autres parce qu’ils sont jaloux de moi et qu’ils veulent rivaliser avec moi. Mais d’autres le font parce qu’ils veulent m’aider.

es.L: Algunos, a la verdad, proclaman al {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} incluso por envidia y rivalidad, pero otros también por buena voluntad.
es.B: Es cierto que algunos predican {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} por envidia y espíritu de rivalidad; otros lo hacen de buena voluntad.
es.R: Algunos les hablan a otros {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} porque me tienen envidia y quieren competir conmigo. Pero otros lo hacen porque quieren ayudar.

sw.L: Kweli wengine wanamhubiri {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hata kwa husuda na ugomvi, lakini wengine pia kwa nia njema.
sw.B: Ni kweli kwamba wengine wanamhubiri {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa wivu na roho ya kushindana; wengine wanafanya hivyo kwa nia njema.
sw.R: Watu wengine wanawaeleza wengine habari za {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa sababu wananionea wivu na wanataka kushindana nami. Lakini wengine wanafanya hivyo kwa sababu wanataka kusaidia.

ko.L: 어떤 사람들은 시기와 다툼으로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 전하고, 어떤 사람들은 선한 뜻으로 [전합니다].
ko.B: 어떤 사람들은 시기심과 경쟁심으로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 전하고, 어떤 사람들은 선한 뜻으로 전합니다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람들은 나를 시기하고 나와 경쟁하고 싶어서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}에 대해 전합니다. 그러나 다른 사람들은 나를 도우려는 마음으로 그렇게 합니다.

vi.L: Thật có một số người rao giảng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} vì lòng ganh tị và tranh giành, nhưng cũng có người vì thiện ý.
vi.B: Thật vậy, có một số người rao giảng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} vì ganh tị và muốn tranh giành; những người khác thì làm điều đó với thiện ý.
vi.R: Có một số người nói về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} vì họ ganh tị với tôi và muốn tranh đua với tôi. Nhưng cũng có những người làm điều đó vì họ muốn giúp đỡ.

pt.L: Alguns, de fato, proclamam o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} até por inveja e rivalidade, mas outros também por boa vontade.
pt.B: Alguns, é verdade, anunciam {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} por inveja e espírito de rivalidade; outros o fazem por boa vontade.
pt.R: Algumas pessoas falam {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} aos outros porque têm inveja de mim e querem competir comigo. Mas outras fazem isso porque querem ajudar.

decisions.choice: Christian preachers where Paul was held, with mixed motives
decisions.reason: These people preach the true Christ, which is why Paul can rejoice in verse 18. Contrast 3:2, where he warns against teachers whose message is wrong.

decisions.choice: envy and rivalry, aimed at Paul
decisions.reason: φθόνον is jealousy and ἔριν is quarrelsome rivalry. Verse 17 shows Paul is their target: they want to add to his troubles.

decisions.choice: goodwill toward Paul
decisions.reason: εὐδοκίαν can describe God's good pleasure (2:13), but here it is the preachers' motive, the opposite of envy: they wish Paul well.

decisions.choice: the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting. The Greek has the article here, which Literal keeps.

decisions.choice: jealous of me; want to help
